instruction: With the model open in SolveSpace, import seed_ss_gui_10_trapezoid_plate.dxf from /home/user/Desktop with File > Import, then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Launch SolveSpace from `/usr/bin/solvespace` before importing `seed_ss_gui_10_trapezoid_plate.dxf`. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. Use the existing base edge, center axis, and construction marks to create the final isosceles trapezoid plate with bottom base 140, top base 80, and height 60. The trapezoid must be symmetric about a vertical center axis. Add one center hole of diameter 20 with its center at (70,30). Add two diameter 6 lower holes with centers at (25,20) and (115,20). Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. When the geometry is complete, align the view to the active workplane if needed, then use File > Export 2d View, choose the DXF file type, and save the result as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_10.dxf. Do not use File > Save As for this final DXF export.
